title: Mānakāma
text: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || Na mānakāmassa damo idh-atthi || na monam atthi asamāhitassa || eko araññe viharaṃ pamatto || na maccudheyyassa tareyya pāran ti || || Mānam pahāya susamāhitatto || sucetaso sabbadhi vippamutto || eko araññe viharaṃ appamatto || sa maccudheyyassa tareyya pāran ti || || [page 005] I. 2. 1.] NANDANA-VAGGA 2. 5
